Doom II, Heretic, Hexen and Strife engines are built in. The game data isn't, because it's still copyrighted, so load the WAD from a copy you own. The file stays in this browser and is never uploaded.

Games

Add-ons to load with the game

Which file

doom2.wad for Doom II (also doom.wad, tnt.wad, plutonia.wad, Freedoom). heretic.wad for Heretic. hexen.wad for Hexen. strife1.wad for Strife, plus voices.wad for its spoken dialogue.

Find them in the game's install folder. On Steam, right-click the game, then Manage › Browse local files. The page picks the right engine from the file.

Add-ons such as hexdd.wad (Deathkings) or Doom PWAD mods: select them together with the main WAD.
